prompt.alinti: Plexo is a free download manager that uses all your internet connections at once. It splits a file into small pieces and pulls them through your Wi-Fi, your wired connection, and even your phone's data, all at once. So the download finishes faster. It can run up to 32 connections at once, and the faster ones grab more pieces. You can pause and resume without corrupting the file, and a live grid shows every piece landing. It's a free, open-source alternative to paid download managers like IDM.

yontem.ne: Bir dosyayı parçalara ayırarak aynı anda farklı ağ bağlantılarından (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB tethering) indirir.
Bağlantı hızına göre parçaların dağılımını ayarlar ve indirmeyi hızlandırır.
yontem.alinti: the faster ones grab more pieces
